Retrieve Probabilistic Principal Components

get_prob_pcs.Rd

Extracts the probabilistic principal components (PCs) from a Metabolites object for a specified data layer, with optional exclusions applied.

Usage

get_prob_pcs(
  metabolites,
  layer,
  sample_ids = NULL,
  drop = FALSE,
  as_df = FALSE
)

Arguments

metabolites

A Metabolites object containing the probabilistic PC data.

layer

A character string specifying the data layer from which to extract the probabilistic PCs.

sample_ids

Optional. A vector of column names to extract. Defaults to NULL, meaning all columns are included.

drop

Logical. Whether to drop completely NA rows (i.e. excluded)

as_df

Logical. Whether to return the result as a data.frame. Defaults to FALSE, returning a matrix.

Value

A matrix or data.frame (if as_df = TRUE) containing the probabilistic principal components.

Examples

file <- system.file("extdata", "metabolon_v1_example.xlsx", package = "metaboprep2")
metabolites <- Metabolites(project_name = "MYPROJECT",
                           format       = "metabolon_v1",
                           filepath     = file)
metabolites <- import_data(metabolites)
